Medicube Rosemary PDRN Scalp Serum is a targeted scalp care treatment designed to refresh, nourish, and revitalize the scalp. Enriched with Rosemary and PDRN, this lightweight serum helps maintain a healthy-looking scalp while providing refreshing care without leaving a heavy or greasy feeling.

Benefits

  • Helps nourish and refresh the scalp.

  • Provides lightweight scalp hydration.

  • Helps maintain a healthy-looking scalp.

  • Leaves the scalp feeling fresh and comfortable.

  • Supports healthier-looking hair.

  1. Part your hair to expose the scalp.
